'''2000 Wisconsin State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Wisconsin in April 2000. It is known from Chuck Sonnenburg's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d382">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-25-milwaukee-wi-03-25-00d382/ milwaukee-wi-03-25-00], DeckTech (Chuck "Sonn" Sonnenburg, 25 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-25-milwaukee-wi-03-25-00d382/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' April 2000
* '''Site:''' Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
